1.english_reference: In the six and thirtieth year of the reign of Asa

traditions.WLC: בִּ שְׁנַ֨ת שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים וָ שֵׁשׁ֙ לְ מַלְכ֣וּת אָסָ֔א
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἐν τῷ ὀγδόῳ καὶ τριακοστῷ ἔτει τῆς βασιλείας Ἀσὰ
traditions.VUL: Anno autem trigésimo sexto regni eius ,
traditions.KJV: In the six and thirtieth year of the reign of Asa

1.english_reference: Baasha king of Israel came up against Judah

traditions.WLC: עָלָ֞ה בַּעְשָׁ֤א מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ עַל יְהוּדָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: ἀνέβη Βαασὰ βασιλεὺς Ἰσραὴλ ἐπὶ Ἰούδαν ,
traditions.VUL: ascéndit Báasa rex Israel in Iudam ,
traditions.KJV: Baasha king of Israel came up against Judah ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּ֖בֶן אֶת הָ רָמָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν τὴν Ῥαμὰ
traditions.VUL: et muro circúmdabat Rama ,
traditions.KJV: and built Ramah ,

1.english_reference: to the intent that he might let none go out or come in to Asa king of Judah

traditions.WLC: לְ בִלְתִּ֗י תֵּ֚ת יוֹצֵ֣א וָ בָ֔א לְ אָסָ֖א מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה
traditions.LXX: τοῦ μὴ δοῦναι ἔξοδον καὶ εἴσοδον τῷ Ἀσὰ βασιλεῖ Ἰούδα .
traditions.VUL: ut nullus tute posset égredi et íngredi de regno Asa .
traditions.KJV: to the intent that he might let none go out or come in to Asa king of Judah .

2.english_reference: Then Asa brought out silver and gold out of the treasures of the house of the LORD and of the king ’s house

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּצֵ֨א אָסָ֜א כֶּ֣סֶף וְ זָהָ֗ב מֵ אֹֽצְר֛וֹת בֵּ֥ית יְהוָ֖ה וּ בֵ֣ית הַ מֶּ֑לֶךְ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔλαβεν Ἀσὰ χρυσίον καὶ ἀργύριον ἐκ θησαυρῶν οἴκου Κυρίου καὶ οἴκου τοῦ βασιλέως ,
traditions.VUL: Prótulit ergo Asa argéntum et aurum de thesáuris domus Dómini , et de thesáuris regis ,
traditions.KJV: Then Asa brought out silver and gold out of the treasures of the house of the LORD and of the king ’s house ,

2.english_reference: and sent to Benhadad king of Syria , that dwelt at Damascus , saying

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּשְׁלַ֗ח אֶל בֶּן הֲדַד֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ אֲרָ֔ם הַ יּוֹשֵׁ֥ב בְּ דַרְמֶ֖שֶׂק לֵ אמֹֽר
traditions.LXX: ἀπέστειλεν πρὸς τὸν υἱὸν τοῦ Ἁδὲρ βασιλέως Συρίας τὸν κατοικοῦντα ἐν Δαμασκῷ λέγων .
traditions.VUL: misítque ad Bénadad regem Sýriæ , qui habitábat in Damásco , dicens :
traditions.KJV: and sent to Benhadad king of Syria , that dwelt at Damascus , saying ,

3.english_reference: [ There is ] a league between me and thee , as [ there was ] between my father and thy father

traditions.WLC: בְּרִית֙ בֵּינִ֣ י וּ בֵינֶ֔ ךָ וּ בֵ֥ין אָבִ֖ י וּ בֵ֣ין אָבִ֑י ךָ
traditions.LXX: Διάθου διαθήκην ἀνὰ μέσον ἐμοῦ καὶ σοῦ , καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον τοῦ πατρὸς μοῦ καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον τοῦ πατρὸς σοῦ ·
traditions.VUL: Fœdus inter me et te est , pater quoque meus et pater tuus habuére concórdiam :
traditions.KJV: [ There is ] a league between me and thee , as [ there was ] between my father and thy father :

3.english_reference: behold , I have sent thee silver and gold

traditions.WLC: הִנֵּ֨ה שָׁלַ֤חְתִּֽי לְ ךָ֙ כֶּ֣סֶף וְ זָהָ֔ב
traditions.LXX: ἰδοὺ ἀπέσταλκά σοι χρυσίον καὶ ἀργύριον ,
traditions.VUL: quam ob rem misi tibi argéntum et aurum ,
traditions.KJV: behold , I have sent thee silver and gold ;

3.english_reference: go , break thy league with Baasha king of Israel , that he may depart from me

traditions.WLC: לֵ֞ךְ הָפֵ֣ר בְּרִֽיתְ ךָ֗ אֶת בַּעְשָׁא֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ יַעֲלֶ֖ה מֵ עָלָֽ י
traditions.LXX: δεῦρο καὶ διασκέδασον ἀπ᾽ ἐμοῦ τόν Βαασὰ βασιλέα Ἰσραήλ , ἀπελθέτω ἀπ᾽ ἐμοῦ .
traditions.VUL: ut rupto fœ́dere , quod habes cum Báasa rege Israel , fácias eum a me recédere .
traditions.KJV: go , break thy league with Baasha king of Israel , that he may depart from me .

4.english_reference: And Benhadad hearkened unto king Asa , and sent the captains of his armies against the cities of Israel

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּשְׁמַ֨ע בֶּן הֲדַ֜ד אֶל הַ מֶּ֣לֶךְ אָסָ֗א וַ֠ יִּשְׁלַח אֶת שָׂרֵ֨י הַ חֲיָלִ֤ים אֲשֶׁר ל וֹ֙ אֶל עָרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἤκουσεν υἱὸς Ἁδὲρ τοῦ βασιλέως Ἀσά , καὶ ἀπέστειλεν πρὸς τοὺς ἄρχοντας τῆς δυνάμεως αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὰς πόλεις Ἰσραήλ ,
traditions.VUL: Quo compérto , Bénadad misit príncipes exercítuum suórum ad urbes Israel :
traditions.KJV: And Benhadad hearkened unto king Asa , and sent the captains of his armies against the cities of Israel ;

4.english_reference: and they smote Ijon , and Dan , and Abelmaim , and all the store cities of Naphtali

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּכּוּ֙ אֶת עִיּ֣וֹן וְ אֶת דָּ֔ן וְ אֵ֖ת אָבֵ֣ל מָ֑יִם וְ אֵ֥ת כָּֽל מִסְכְּנ֖וֹת עָרֵ֥י נַפְתָּלִֽי
traditions.LXX: ἐπάταξεν τὴν Ἰὼ καὶ τὴν Δανὼ καὶ τὴν Ἀβελμὰν καὶ πάσας τὰς περιχώρους Νεφθαλεί .
traditions.VUL: qui percussérunt Ahion , et Dan , et Abélmaim , et univérsas urbes Néphthali murátas .
traditions.KJV: and they smote Ijon , and Dan , and Abelmaim , and all the store cities of Naphtali .

5.english_reference: And it came to pass , when Baasha heard [ it ]

traditions.WLC: וַ יְהִי֙ כִּ שְׁמֹ֣עַ בַּעְשָׁ֔א
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ ἀκοῦσαι Βαασά ,
traditions.VUL: Quod cum audísset Báasa ,
traditions.KJV: And it came to pass , when Baasha heard [ it ] ,

5.english_reference: that he left off building of Ramah , and let his work cease

traditions.WLC: וַ יֶּחְדַּ֕ל מִ בְּנ֖וֹת אֶת הָ רָמָ֑ה וַ יַּשְׁבֵּ֖ת אֶת מְלַאכְתּֽ וֹ
traditions.LXX: ἀπέλιπεν τοῦ μηκέτι οἰκοδομεῖν τὴν Ῥαμὰ καὶ κατέπαυσεν τὸ ἔργον αὐτοῦ .
traditions.VUL: désiit ædificáre Rama , et intermísit opus suum .
traditions.KJV: that he left off building of Ramah , and let his work cease .

6.english_reference: Then Asa the king took all Judah

traditions.WLC: וְ אָסָ֣א הַ מֶּ֗לֶךְ לָקַח֙ אֶת כָּל יְהוּדָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ Ἀσὰ ὁ βασιλεὺς ἔλαβεν πάντα τὸν Ἰουδά ,
traditions.VUL: Porro Asa rex assúmpsit univérsum Iudam ,
traditions.KJV: Then Asa the king took all Judah ;

6.english_reference: and they carried away the stones of Ramah , and the timber thereof , wherewith Baasha was building

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּשְׂא֞וּ אֶת אַבְנֵ֤י הָֽ רָמָה֙ וְ אֶת עֵצֶ֔י הָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּנָ֖ה בַּעְשָׁ֑א
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔλαβεν τοὺς λίθους τῆς Ῥαμὰ καὶ τὰ ξύλα αὐτῆς ἃ ᾠκοδόμησεν Βαασά ,
traditions.VUL: et tulérunt lápides de Rama , et ligna quæ ædificatióni præparáverat Báasa ,
traditions.KJV: and they carried away the stones of Ramah , and the timber thereof , wherewith Baasha was building ;

6.english_reference: and he built therewith Geba and Mizpah

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּ֣בֶן בָּ הֶ֔ם אֶת גֶּ֖בַע וְ אֶת הַ מִּצְפָּֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν ἐν αὐτοῖς τὴν Γάβαε καὶ τὴν Μασφά .
traditions.VUL: ædificavítque ex eis Gábaa , et Maspha .
traditions.KJV: and he built therewith Geba and Mizpah .

7.english_reference: And at that time Hanani the seer came to Asa king of Judah , and said unto him

traditions.WLC: וּ בָ עֵ֣ת הַ הִ֗יא בָּ֚א חֲנָ֣נִי הָ רֹאֶ֔ה אֶל אָסָ֖א מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה וַ יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֗י
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐν τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ ἦλθεν Ἁναμεὶ ὁ προφήτης πρὸς Ἀσὰ βασιλέα Ἰούδα καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ
traditions.VUL: In témpore illo venit Hánani prophéta ad Asa regem Iuda , et dixit ei :
traditions.KJV: And at that time Hanani the seer came to Asa king of Judah , and said unto him ,

7.english_reference: Because thou hast relied on the king of Syria , and not relied on the LORD thy God

traditions.WLC: ו בְּ הִשָּׁ֨עֶנְ ךָ֜ עַל מֶ֤לֶךְ אֲרָם֙ וְ לֹ֤א נִשְׁעַ֨נְתָּ֙ עַל יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י ךָ
traditions.LXX: Ἐν τῷ πεποιθέναι σε ἐπὶ βασιλέα Συρίας καὶ μὴ πεποιθέναι σε ἐπὶ Κύριον θεόν σου ,
traditions.VUL: Quia habuísti fidúciam in rege Sýriæ , et non in Dómino Deo tuo ,
traditions.KJV: Because thou hast relied on the king of Syria , and not relied on the LORD thy God ,

7.english_reference: therefore is the host of the king of Syria escaped out of thine hand

traditions.WLC: עַל כֵּ֗ן נִמְלַ֛ט חֵ֥יל מֶֽלֶךְ אֲרָ֖ם מִ יָּדֶֽ ךָ
traditions.LXX: διὰ τοῦτο ἐσώθη δύναμις Συρίας ἀπὸ τῆς χειρός σου .
traditions.VUL: idcírco evásit Sýriæ regis exércitus de manu tua .
traditions.KJV: therefore is the host of the king of Syria escaped out of thine hand .

8.english_reference: Were not the Ethiopians and the Lubims a huge host , with very many chariots and horsemen ?

traditions.WLC: הֲ לֹ֧א הַ כּוּשִׁ֣ים וְ הַ לּוּבִ֗ים הָי֨וּ לְ חַ֧יִל לָ רֹ֛ב לְ רֶ֥כֶב וּ לְ פָרָשִׁ֖ים לְ הַרְבֵּ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד
traditions.LXX: οὐχ οἱ Αἰθίοπες καὶ Λίβυες ἦσαν εἰς δύναμιν πολλὴν εἰς θάρσος , εἰς ἱππεῖς εἰς πλῆθος σφόδρα ;
traditions.VUL: Nonne Æthíopes , et Líbyes multo plures erant quadrígis , et equítibus , et multitúdine nímia :
traditions.KJV: Were not the Ethiopians and the Lubims a huge host , with very many chariots and horsemen ?

8.english_reference: yet , because thou didst rely on the LORD , he delivered them into thine hand

traditions.WLC: וּ בְ הִשָּֽׁעֶנְ ךָ֥ עַל יְהוָ֖ה נְתָנָ֥ ם בְּ יָדֶֽ ךָ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐν τῷ πεποιθέναι σε ἐπὶ Κύριον παρέδωκεν εἰς τὰς χεῖράς σου .
traditions.VUL: quos , cum Dómino credidísses , trádidit in manu tua ?
traditions.KJV: yet , because thou didst rely on the LORD , he delivered them into thine hand .

9.english_reference: For the eyes of the LORD run to and fro throughout the whole earth , to shew himself strong in the behalf of [ them ] whose heart [ is ] perfect toward him

traditions.WLC: כִּ֣י יְהוָ֗ה עֵינָ֞י ו מְשֹׁטְט֤וֹת בְּ כָל הָ אָ֨רֶץ֙ לְ֠ הִתְחַזֵּק עִם לְבָבָ֥ ם שָׁלֵ֛ם אֵלָ֖י
traditions.LXX: ὅτι οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ Κυρίου ἐπιβλέπουσιν ἐν πάσῃ τῇ γῇ κατισχῦσαι ἐν πάσῃ καρδίᾳ πλήρει ἐπὶ τοῦ πρὸς αὐτόν .
traditions.VUL: Oculi enim Dómini contemplántur univérsam terram , et præbent fortitúdinem his , qui corde perfécto credunt in eum .
traditions.KJV: For the eyes of the LORD run to and fro throughout the whole earth , to shew himself strong in the behalf of [ them ] whose heart [ is ] perfect toward him .

traditions.WLC: ו נִסְכַּ֣לְתָּ עַל זֹ֑את
traditions.LXX: ἠγνόηκας ἐπὶ τούτῳ ·
traditions.VUL: Stulte ígitur egísti ,
traditions.KJV: Herein thou hast done foolishly :

9.english_reference: therefore from henceforth thou shalt have wars

traditions.WLC: כִּ֣י מֵ עַ֔תָּה יֵ֥שׁ עִמְּ ךָ֖ מִלְחָמֽוֹת
traditions.LXX: ἀπὸ τοῦ νῦν ἔστιν μετὰ σοῦ πόλεμος .
traditions.VUL: et propter hoc ex præsénti témpore advérsum te bella consúrgent .
traditions.KJV: therefore from henceforth thou shalt have wars .

10.english_reference: Then Asa was wroth with the seer

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּכְעַ֨ס אָסָ֜א אֶל הָ רֹאֶ֗ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐθυμώθη Ἀσὰ τῷ προφήτῃ ,
traditions.VUL: Iratúsque Asa advérsus vidéntem ,
traditions.KJV: Then Asa was wroth with the seer ,

10.english_reference: and put him in a prison house ; for [ he was ] in a rage with him because of this [ thing ]

traditions.WLC: וַֽ יִּתְּנֵ֨ הוּ֙ בֵּ֣ית הַ מַּהְפֶּ֔כֶת כִּֽי בְ זַ֥עַף עִמּ֖ וֹ עַל זֹ֑את
traditions.LXX: καὶ παρέθετο αὐτὸν εἰς φυλακὴν ἐπὶ τούτῳ ·
traditions.VUL: iussit eum mitti in nervum : valde quippe super hoc fúerat indignátus :
traditions.KJV: and put him in a prison house ; for [ he was ] in a rage with him because of this [ thing ] .

10.english_reference: And Asa oppressed [ some ] of the people the same time

traditions.WLC: וַ יְרַצֵּ֥ץ אָסָ֛א מִן הָ עָ֖ם בָּ עֵ֥ת הַ הִֽיא
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐλυμήνατο Ἀσὰ ἐν τῷ λαῷ ἐν τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ .
traditions.VUL: et interfécit de pópulo in témpore illo plúrimos .
traditions.KJV: And Asa oppressed [ some ] of the people the same time .

11.english_reference: And , behold , the acts of Asa , first and last ,

traditions.WLC: וְ הִנֵּה֙ דִּבְרֵ֣י אָסָ֔א הָ רִאשׁוֹנִ֖ים וְ הָ אַחֲרוֹנִ֑ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἰδοὺ οἱ λόγοι Ἀσὰ οἱ πρῶτοι καὶ οἱ ἔσχατοι
traditions.VUL: Opera autem Asa prima et novíssima
traditions.KJV: And , behold , the acts of Asa , first and last ,

11.english_reference: lo , they [ are ] written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel .

traditions.WLC: הִנָּ֤ ם כְּתוּבִים֙ עַל סֵ֣פֶר הַ מְּלָכִ֔ים לִ יהוּדָ֖ה וְ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
traditions.LXX: γεγραμμένοι ἐν βιβλίῳ βασιλέων Ἰούδα καὶ Ἰσραήλ .
traditions.VUL: scripta sunt in Libro regum Iuda et Israel .
traditions.KJV: lo , they [ are ] written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel .

12.english_reference: And Asa in the thirty and ninth year of his reign was diseased in his feet ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יֶּחֱלֶ֣א אָסָ֡א בִּ שְׁנַת֩ שְׁלוֹשִׁ֨ים וָ תֵ֤שַׁע לְ מַלְכוּת וֹ֙ בְּ רַגְלָ֔י
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐμαλακίσθη Ἀσὰ ἐν τῷ ἐνάτῳ καὶ τριακοστῷ ἔτει τῆς βασιλείας αὐτοῦ τοὺς πόδας ,
traditions.VUL: Ægrotávit étiam Asa anno trigésimo nono regni sui , dolóre pedum vehementíssimo ,
traditions.KJV: And Asa in the thirty and ninth year of his reign was diseased in his feet ,

12.english_reference: until his disease [ was ] exceeding [ great ] :

traditions.WLC: ו עַד לְ מַ֖עְלָ ה חָלְי֑ וֹ
traditions.LXX: ἕως σφόδρα ἐμαλακίσθη ·
traditions.KJV: until his disease [ was ] exceeding [ great ] :

12.english_reference: yet in his disease he sought not to the LORD , but to the physicians .

traditions.WLC: וְ גַם בְּ חָלְי וֹ֙ לֹא דָרַ֣שׁ אֶת יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֖י בָּ רֹפְאִֽים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐν τῇ μαλακίᾳ αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἐζήτησεν Κύριον ἀλλὰ τοὺς ἰατρούς .
traditions.VUL: et nec in infirmitáte sua quæsívit Dóminum , sed magis in medicórum arte confísus est .
traditions.KJV: yet in his disease he sought not to the LORD , but to the physicians .

13.english_reference: And Asa slept with his fathers ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּשְׁכַּ֥ב אָסָ֖א עִם אֲבֹתָ֑י
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐκοιμήθη Ἀσὰ μετὰ τῶν πατέρων αὐτοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: Dormivítque cum pátribus suis ,
traditions.KJV: And Asa slept with his fathers ,

13.english_reference: and died in the one and fortieth year of his reign .

traditions.WLC: ו וַ יָּ֕מָת בִּ שְׁנַ֛ת אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וְ אַחַ֖ת לְ מָלְכֽ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐτελεύτησεν ἐν τῷ τριακοστῷ ἔτει τῆς βασιλείας αὐτοῦ .
traditions.VUL: et mórtuus est anno quadragésimo primo regni sui .
traditions.KJV: and died in the one and fortieth year of his reign .

14.english_reference: And they buried him in his own sepulchres , which he had made for himself in the city of David ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּקְבְּרֻ֣ הוּ בְ קִבְרֹתָ֗י ו אֲשֶׁ֣ר כָּֽרָה ל וֹ֮ בְּ עִ֣יר דָּוִיד֒
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔθαψαν αὐτὸν ἐν τῷ μνήματι ᾧ ὤρυξεν ἑαυτῷ ἐν πόλει Δαυεἰδ ,
traditions.VUL: Et sepeliérunt eum in sepúlcro suo , quod fóderat sibi in civitáte David :
traditions.KJV: And they buried him in his own sepulchres , which he had made for himself in the city of David ,

14.english_reference: and laid him in the bed which was filled with sweet odours and divers kinds [ of spices ] prepared by the apothecaries ’ art :

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּשְׁכִּיבֻ֗ הוּ בַּ מִּשְׁכָּב֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר מִלֵּא֙ בְּשָׂמִ֣ים וּ זְנִ֔ים מְרֻקָּחִ֖ים בְּ מִרְקַ֣חַת מַעֲשֶׂ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐκοίμισαν αὐτὸν ἐπὶ τῆς κλίνης , καὶ ἔπλησαν ἀρωμάτων καὶ γένη μύρων μυρεψῶν ,
traditions.VUL: posuerúntque eum super lectum suum plenum aromátibus et unguéntibus meretríciis , quæ erant pigmentariórum arte confécta ,
traditions.KJV: and laid him in the bed which was filled with sweet odours and divers kinds [ of spices ] prepared by the apothecaries ’ art :

14.english_reference: and they made a very great burning for him .

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּשְׂרְפוּ ל֥ וֹ שְׂרֵפָ֖ה גְּדוֹלָ֥ה עַד לִ מְאֹֽד
traditions.LXX: ἐποίησαν αὐτῷ ἐκφορὰν μεγάλην σφόδρα .
traditions.VUL: et combussérunt super eum ambitióne nímia .
traditions.KJV: and they made a very great burning for him .
